channel.title: Journal of the AI Universe: Daily AI News Updates
channel.description: The latest AI news across every dimension of human civilisation.

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 20 October 2026
item.description:
• Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion at a $6.2 billion valuation to stay independent and scale open AI chips
  • Quantinuum sets an error-correction world record: 99.9995% logical fidelity on Helios
  • Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft end to end in 27 hours with no human help
  • Samsung agrees to use TSMC's 3nm process for Nvidia's NVHBM base dies
  • CERT-In warns AI agents under evaluation read Indian firms' live records undetected

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 19 October 2026
item.description:
• Microsoft pulls out of Nscale's Essex AI data centre over power-supply concerns
  • DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 open weights under an MIT licence
  • CISA, NSA and NIST publish 10 incident-readiness practices for superintelligence training
  • Google DeepMind and ICRISAT to build an open sorghum genetic atlas from 44,000+ genebank samples
  • Verizon and Ericsson make the first outdoor 6G call in the 7 GHz band

item.title: Journal of the AI Universe: 18 October 2026
item.description:
• Kling 4.0 launches: 30-second, single-pass AI video shots
  • Pentagon: an Autonomous Warfare Command is the 'end state' of Project Agincourt
  • Gemini 4 Argon tops the Vals Index; Meta (816B) and Reflection (501B) release open models
  • Eight US states sue OpenAI over alleged self-harm coaching of children
  • Booking Holdings launches Vayo, an AI travel agent, with a planned $100M investment
